layers.deciding_comparison: No measured winner is established. On WSL2 x86_64, with a macOS arm64 repeat, compare Letta Code against the direct clients using identical native-account entitlements, models, tasks, tool permissions and effect checks. Measure coding correctness, bounded-research citation accuracy, tool compatibility, and interruption/resume without duplicated effects. Compare a native client with its supported SDK only after identifying a concrete missing event, tool or recovery requirement, and align underlying engine versions; none was established here.
evidence_gaps: The required ctx_fetch_and_index calls were rejected: 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never.' GitHub API responses and README source were instead indexed and read through ctx_search; external documentation and papers remain unverified.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, one web search, and eight attempted page fetches, none successful. Only the packet was read under the working directory.
There is no completed comparison in the packet and no verified comparative benchmark separating the leading clients. Selections reflect documented capability fit, not measured superiority.

All seven identifiable repositories are unarchived and have default-branch commits within 90 days. All latest releases are within 90 days except the retired Letta server's May 14 release. Issue response and resolution activity were not assessed.

Only Codex and Letta Code CI outcomes were retrieved. Letta Code's main CI passed, while its scheduled Claude Agent Watch failed; neither result establishes comparative task quality. Test counts, job logs and platform matrices were not verified.

No clean-install, account-entitlement, bounded-research or recovery tests ran on the target hosts. Codex's bounded web-research configuration and the Claude Agent SDK's native-account authentication were not established by the inspected sources.

Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 distributions were verified for the selected clients. Letta Code explicitly mentions WSL, but its architecture-specific support was not verified. GPU performance was not scored because the packet specifies no local GPU requirement.

License was not scored. Claude Code's complete-client open-source status remains unverified. Claude Agent SDK metadata identifies MIT while its README separately describes Commercial Terms and component exceptions; their legal relationship was not verified.
